build_functorch_wheel: build a functorch wheel package with C++ extensions and PyTorch dependencies
clean_build_artifacts: run the custom clean command to remove build artifacts and gitignored files
get_cpp_extensions: get C++ extension modules for functorch with configurable debug and release compile flags
write_version_file: write a version.py file containing the package version and git commit hash
configure_extras_require: configure optional extras like aot that depend on networkx for ahead-of-time compilation
